PLAN "Bodyweight + Bar Strength (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational full-body strength with minimal equipment"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 4x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower + Push":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body + Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40..60 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Pull + Core":
        warmup:
